hrda.events.logging.enabled.description: An administrator switched the general event log on.

hrda.events.logging.disabled.description: An administrator switched the general event log off. Always written, even with the log off.

hrda.events.publishing.enabled.description: An administrator switched publishing to external subscribers on.

hrda.events.publishing.disabled.description: An administrator switched publishing to external subscribers off. Published itself, as the last one.

hrda.auth.session.started.description: A user signed in. method: google | person_id.

hrda.auth.sign_in.failed.description: A sign-in failed. reason: bad_credentials | locked | bad_link (expired or used set-password link) | provider_error. login_digest: HMAC of the attempted PersonID.

hrda.auth.sign_in.locked.description: Too many failed sign-ins: a PersonID (scope login) or an address (scope ip) is locked until the given time.

hrda.auth.first_sign_in.requested.description: Someone asked to set or reset the password of a PersonID. outcome: sent | unknown | no_contact | conflict | disabled | locked.

hrda.auth.password.set.description: A user set their password through the e-mailed link.

hrda.auth.confirmation.succeeded.description: A user confirmed an action with their password or a fresh sign-in.

hrda.auth.confirmation.failed.description: A wrong password was given to confirm an action.

hrda.accounts.user.created.description: An account was created: by a first Google sign-in, or for a person asking to sign in with their PersonID.

hrda.accounts.access.changed.description: An administrator changed an account's role or access profiles.

hrda.privacy.export.downloaded.description: A person downloaded their own data. format: pdf | markdown | json.

hrda.documents.document.signed.description: A document was signed (its type only).
